主要内容: On June 21, 2012, Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. adopted the Incentive Compensation Plan, a performance-based cash bonus program for executive officers. The Compensation Committee will determine performance periods and set specific objectives within the first 90 days of each period. Bonus levels will be based on actual performance, with thresholds, targets, and above-target levels defined for each objective. For 2012, executive officers' target bonuses are 50%, 40%, and 30% of base salary, respectively. Philip Gregory and Dale Ando have 20% of their bonuses tied to individual performance, while 80% is based on corporate performance, with a minimum threshold of 70% achievement. Corporate objectives include advancing clinical trials for SB-728-T in HIV/AIDS, preclinical ZFP Therapeutic candidates, completing at least one corporate partnership, initiating ZFP Therapeutic research programs, and maintaining cash reserves of approximately $60 million. Dr. Gregory's primary individual objective is achieving the research component of corporate objectives, with additional goals related to organizational enhancements and business development support.
